title: Meeting Rooms
description: Given an array of meeting time intervals consisting of start and end times `intervals` where `intervals[i] = [start_i, end_i]`, determine if a person could attend all meetings without overlap.

examples.explanation: Since [0,30] overlaps with [5,10] and [15,20], the person cannot attend all meetings.
No intervals overlap, so the person can attend both meetings.

hints: Sort the intervals by start time.
Check if any meeting starts before the previous meeting has ended.
